gaps.sentence: Only after the interview ___ I realise how nervous I had been.
gaps.explanation: Only after X did I realise… — inversion.

gaps.sentence: So ___ was the crowd that the concert was postponed.
gaps.explanation: So great was the crowd that… = the crowd was so great that…

gaps.sentence: So convincing ___ his argument that nobody objected.
gaps.explanation: So + adjective at the front: was his argument that…

gaps.sentence: Only after the third attempt ___ she pass the test.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after' at the front forces question word order: did she pass.

gaps.sentence: Never ___ I imagine the project would take two years.
gaps.explanation: Never would I have imagined… — conditional flavour with inversion.

gaps.sentence: Under no circumstances ___ this door be left unlocked.
gaps.explanation: Under no circumstances + must + subject + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: Never before ___ the city seen flooding on this scale.
gaps.explanation: Never before had the city seen… — past perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only in an emergency ___ this exit be used.
gaps.explanation: may + be + participle: this exit may be used only in an emergency.
